items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But, I worked with Ella often on for about four or 4 1/2 years.

ctx.x: Your association with Ella Fitzgerald began through JATP?

Actually, began during a time where JATP was not on tour. And it continued the next tour with JATP. Then, it continued for the next two or three years. But, I worked with Ella often on for about four or 4 1/2 years. That is not an awful long time. Tony when he worked with her for 15 years, which is a long time. But, it was very hard. She was very interesting to work with and very pleasant. She was a wonderful artist. She can do ballads as well as scat. She did a great scat. She was a great scat singer.

I thinking over this earlier but, and I'm not sure it was on the tape or not on the tape, but talk about what it was that she wanted from a pianist. What did she want the pianist to supply, what was she looking for, and did that in any way influence your development as a player?
